meta.name: arize-annotation
meta.description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when creating, managing, or using annotation configs or annotation queues on Arize (categorical, continuous, freeform), or applying human annotations to project spans via the Python SDK. Configs are the label schema for human feedback; queues are review workflows that route records to annotators. Triggers: annotation config, annotation queue, label schema, human feedback schema, bulk annotate spans, update_annotations, labeling queue, annotate record.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和管理标注配置与审核队列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Arize平台上为项目配置人工标注流程。
copy.tagline_en: Create and manage annotation configs and review queues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up human annotation workflows on Arize.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 可以帮你在 Arize 平台上创建和管理标注配置（分类、连续、自由文本）以及标注队列，还能通过 Python SDK 批量给项目跨度打标签。
howto.when: 当你想定义人工反馈的标签架构（比如正确性评分），或者需要管理审核工作流（比如分配标注任务给评审员）时，Claude 会接管操作。

say.text: 帮我在 Arize 空间中创建一个名为“正确性”的分类标注配置。
列出当前空间中的所有标注队列。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can help you create and manage annotation configs (categorical, continuous, freeform) and annotation queues on Arize, and also bulk-apply annotations to project spans via the Python SDK.
howto.when_en: When you need to define the label schema for human feedback, or manage review workflows that route records to human annotators, Claude will take over.

say_en.text: Create a categorical annotation config named 'Correctness' in my Arize space.
List all annotation queues in the current space.
Bulk-update annotations for spans span_001 and span_002 using the Python SDK.
